title: Clinical Trial Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Navepegritide and Lonapegsomatropin in Achondroplasia
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Active Controlled, Multi-center Trial Investigating the Efficacy and Safety of Dual Therapy With Once-weekly Navepegritide and Once-weekly Lonapegsomatropin Compared to Navepegritide Monotherapy and Lonapegsomatropin Monotherapy in Children and Adolescents With Achondroplasia
summary: This pivotal trial is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of dual therapy with navepegritide and lonapegsomatropin administered as separate subcutaneous (SC) injections once weekly in children with achondroplasia (ACH) aged 2 to 17 years.

interventions.name: Dual therapy with navepegritide and lonapegsomatropin
Dual therapy with navepegritide and placebo for lonapegsomatropin
Dual therapy with lonapegsomatropin and placebo for navepegritide

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Age 2 to \<18 years at randomization
* 2\. Clinical diagnosis of ACH with historical genetic confirmation
* 3\. At least 1 height measurement available from medical records

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Treatment with growth hormone within 1 year prior to randomization
* 2\. Prior treatment with certain medication(s) which potentially could have affected growth (prior treatment with vosoritide is not exclusive)
* 3\. History of any surgery intended to affect stature, growth, or body proportionality except procedures for leg bowing
* 4\. Unable to stand without assistance
* 5\. Known or suspected medical conditions other than achondroplasia that could affect growth
* 6\. Known history or presence of injury of the growth plates that affects growth potential of long bones
* 7\. Known history or presence of malignant disease
